    • aclUpdate

      public void aclUpdate(Map<String,Object> args)
      Update the access control list (ACL) properties for this entity,
      Parameters:
      args - : Properties to update for this entity. Required Properties in 'args' - `owner`: The Splunk username, such as "admin". A value of "nobody" means no specific user. - `sharing`: A mode that indicates how the resource is shared. The sharing mode can be "user", "app", "global", or "system".
